title: Restoration models
description: 32 restoration models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.
html:
32 restoration models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: one RGB image. Output: the restored (upscaled) image, model.scale x the input size, RGB in [0, 1]. tile= runs large images in overlapping tiles (as ComfyUI).

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130; fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW measures yours. The summary uses one input, 512x512: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under torch.compile and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable (export; memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured; no kernels = the family has no kernels backend (reason under its table). Reserved memory is the allocator's cache: kernels (CUDA graphs, cuDNN workspaces) can reserve a few percent to some tens of percent more than portable at the same allocated peak.

Other devices: Apple M1 Pro 16 GB, Apple M1 Pro 16 GB (MLX), NVIDIA L4, NVIDIA L40S, NVIDIA A10, NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000; across devices.
